_about: MIG-416 (2026-10-21): what e2e/perf.spec.ts holds each main page to, as a workspace administrator at 1920 and 1024, a full load with the HTTP cache warm. Measured on the development Mac (Lakeside Home Health, 428 reports, 7 templates): time to content 94-266 ms, LCP 52-232 ms, no long task, 57-98 requests a page, heap 11-15 MB after a GC with 1-3 MB over two more walks. Budgets: time to content 2,000 ms (about 8x, so a busy Mac passes and a page that waits on a slow call fails); LCP 2,500 ms and CLS 0.1, the Web Vitals 'good' thresholds; 300 ms of long tasks; requests about 1.5x the page's count (a page that starts fetching per row fails); heap 60 MB and 10 MB of growth over two walks (a leak). Runs measured CLS 0.29 at 1024 before its explorer was drawn whole (MIG-416). AWS budgets come with MIG-327.
